column1: # R16: StarBeast3 with the relaxed species-tree clock. BEAUti 2.7's StarBeast3 template also logs
# beastlabs TreeDistanceLogger columns (each gene tree's distance to its NJ and UPGMA tree) and the
# per-branch popSize.N, which BEAST 3 does not log. The tree distances change only when a gene-tree
# topology changes, so they mix slowly (ESS < 30 in some 100M-step replicates) and get no better
# with longer chains; the gene-tree topologies themselves are compared from the tree files.
